data.one_liner: CLI tool to scan Flutter and Dart projects for unused .dart files.
data.what_it_does: Scans all Dart files in a Flutter or Dart project, analyzes dependencies and reachability from entry points, and reports unused files that can be safely removed. It supports custom paths, file patterns, and folder exclusions.
use_when: You want to clean up dead code and reduce codebase size.
You are preparing a project for maintenance or a major refactor.
avoid_when: Your project relies on dynamic file loading or custom reflection that static analysis cannot track.
strengths: Accurate detection with built-in default exclusions for generated code.
Customizable scan paths, file patterns, and folder exclusions.
weaknesses: May require manual review to prevent false positives in highly dynamic codebases.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally via pub using `dart pub global activate dart_unused_files`.
